name: uberasm-preserve-flight-through-a-level-transition
title: Preserve Flight Through a Level Transition
description:
Allows you to preserve Mario's flight, including his speed and direction, through a level transition, such as a pipe, door or teleport block. There are some limitations that are noted in the ASM file.

Uses 1 byte of FreeRAM as a flag and 7 more as a backup for player states.
